execution.description: Built the stage profile and Graphite's per-stage enforcement on #504's provider.

expected: Every Graphite session in step 4 runs under the stage profile.
observed: #504's Constructor runner registers its own Level-0 permission profile (phase3.permission_profile) as the campaign profile and every task's, so a staged provider would refuse its tasks. The stage profile is enforced for the Attacker only; the Constructor block runs unstaged.
keep: A staged provider refuses a task whose profile is not the stage profile's digest; nothing composes profiles silently.
change: After #504 merges, compose the stage profile with each runner's own permission profile so every Graphite campaign is staged.

proposed_revision.text: Every Graphite runner that acts on a Challenge registers, as its campaign profile and every task's, the stage profile composed with that runner's own permission profile, when it has one: the Constructor's Level-0 permission profile, at the stage profile's level and for its Challenge; the Attacker has none beyond its role's closed tool manifest. The staged provider then refuses, for every such role and not only the Attacker, a role outside the stage's ledger row, a construction level that differs from the inventory's and a changed ledger, and a runner refuses an unstaged provider.
